Commentary.Commentary: So that ends our formalities for this match. Hope you enjoyed this high voltage contest with the Kiwi side leveling the 5-match series 1-1 to only make it more exciting. Do join us for the 3rd ODI in Wellington on 25th February at 1400 local (0100 GMT). Till then, goodbye and cheers!

Ross Taylor is adjudged Man of the Match for setting up the game for New Zealand with a terrific century. He mixed caution with aggression to perfection and led the Kiwi side to a good score on a slowish track.

South Africa will be disappointed with their performance. Their top order once again failed to play an anchoring knock and there were no lower order heroics to save them today. AB de Villiers talked about identifying the chinks in the armour going into the Champions Trophy and the Kiwis have just exposed a few. Should be interesting to see how the visitors come back in the next game.

Overall a very good day for the hosts. They first put up a par score on the board thanks to Ross Taylor's century with vital contributions from Kane Williamson and Jimmy Neesham. With the ball, Trent Boult was the best bowler for them with 3/63. Santner too was vital with his 2/46. They have now leveled the series 1-1 with three games to go.

Defending a score of 289, the hosts struck early taking out Hashim Amla and Faf du Plessis but the pair of Quinton de Kock and JP Duminy kept them in the game with a 57-run stand. Once Duminy departed it was only AB de Villiers who was fighting for the visitors as the required run-rate kept on climbing and wickets started to fall at the other end. The pair of Dwaine and Andile though brought them back with a stand of 61 runs in just 44 balls as NZ started to feel the heat, Boult and Southee though held their nerve to see their team through.

Phew! Two games in this series and we have witnessed two thrillers already. What a great leveler the game of cricket is. In the previous encounter, Andile Phehlukwayo was the one who did the hitting despite having AB de Villiers around but this time he could not take his team to victory, needing 15 runs in the last over. It was Dwaine Pretorius though who brought them back in the game, scoring a 27-ball fifty but alas it went in vain.

What a game, Andile hits a FOUR but New Zealand take the game! Hurls it fuller on the stumps, Andile makes room and hammers it over the head of Tahir. The ball races down the ground for a boundary. Won't be enough for them, NEW ZEALAND WIN BY 6 RUNS!
FOUR! A bit too late? Angles it full around off, Andile thinks about the reverse now and gets it down to third man for a boundary. 11 needed in 1 ball.
Too full outside off, Andile can only dig it out towards extra cover where Kane Williamson fields the ball. Surely, the game is sealed for the hosts here.
Full and wide outside off, Andile gets it down to third man off the outer half of the bat. No run taken again. 15 needed in 3 balls.
Full again outside off, Phehlukwayo hits it hard towards extra cover and again fails to beat the fielder.
Fuller outside off, Andile spanks it hard towards extra cover but fails to find the gap. He denies the single too.
Imran Tahir is the last man in. South Africa need 15 runs in 6 balls, with Andile on strike. We are in for another thriller here.

OUT! Boult strikes when needed the most! That ends a tremendous knock of Pretorius under pressure. Trent steams in and bowls a full toss on leg stump. Pretorius backs away and comes down the track to hit it over covers but misses it completely as the ball thuds into the stumps. South Africa have lost a very untimely wicket. They need 15 runs to win off the last over with a sole wicket in hand.
Driven towards the mid on region. They pick up a single.

Full delivery attacking the stumps, Phehlukwayo has a swing across the line but drags it from the inner half through backward square leg. Sharp running between the wickets allows the batsmen to come back for a couple.
Maiden ODI fifty for Dwaine Pretorius!

Intelligent bowling by Boult. Pretorius makes room but Boult bowls a yorker length ball on leg stump. Pretorius squeezes it behind point for a single. It has been a terrific half century under pressure by Pretorius. What composure and clean hitting!
Fullish ball attacking the stumps, Phehlukwayo backs away and hits it to long on. Single taken!
That's a terrific start to the over from Boult. Gets it right in the blockhole as Andile makes room to open up spaces in the field. Has to contend with keeping that one out.
Trent Boult returns for his final over. Can he put in a fine over here? NZ need it badly.
Too full on the stumps, Andile gets it down to long on for a single. 13 runs off it. South Africa need 20 more runs in 12 balls.
Fuller outside off, Andile plays all over it and is beaten comprehensively.
Angled on the pads, tucked through square leg for a single.
WIDE! This is very wide outside off, left alone by DP. A wide is signaled.
Full outside off, Dwaine carves it through covers for a single. The throw is a touch wide and that allows the batsman to come back for the second.
FOUR! Slammed! This one is on the stumps, Dwaine does not miss out and clobbers it down the ground for a boundary. The fielder at long on, tries to cut it of but fails to do so.
FOUR! Top shot! Full outside off, Dwaine gets it down to third man fence with an angled bat.
Kane Williamson spots the danger and calls back Tim Southee.
Shortish outside off, Andile rocks back and hits it hard to the man at short cover. Only 4 from it, great over by Ish Sodhi. South Africa need 33 from 18 balls with two wickets in hand.
Tossed up outside off, driven to deep cover for a single.

Poor delivery by Sodhi as he bowls it way too short and it's going down leg, Dwaine stays deep in the crease and pulls it through backward square leg. Boult sprints across and dives full length to make a brilliant save. Keeps it down to two.
Shortish delivery outside off, Phehlukwayo cuts it towards point where the fielder fumbles and concedes a single.
Sodhi slips in a googly around off, Andile has a heave across the line but gets beaten. Latham collects the ball and flicks the bails in a jiffy but Andile is safe.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Andile makes room and Boult follows him with a full length ball. He pushes it to mid off for a quick single. 15 runs from that over.
How did that miss the stumps? Boult bowls a terrific yorker around off stump, Andile looks to block it out but gets beaten all ends up as the ball misses the off pole by a whisker.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Wide! Boult gets his radar wrong yet again and sprays it full down the leg side, Pretorius looks to glance it but misses.
Wide! Slips this one down the leg side, Dwaine looks to work it through but misses.

FOUR! Lucky runs but South Africa will take it with open hands! Very full outside off, Dwaine looks to carve it square of the wicket but gets a thick inside edge that beats the keeper and runs to the fine leg fence. This match is not over yet by any stretch of imagination.

SIX! That's muscled away! Boult bangs in a short delivery around off, sits up nicely for Pretorius. He stands tall and gives it the full monte over deep mid-wicket and the ball clears the fence with ease.
Boult starts off his new spell with a full toss. Phehlukwayo backs away and hits it hard to deep cover. Single taken!
Trent Boult brought back into the attack.
Drops it short outside off, punched through covers for a single. South Africa need 52 more in 30 balls.
Shorter outside off, Andile goes back and whips it hard through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Shorter on leg, tucked towards mid on for a single as the bowler himself has to field it towards mid on.
SIX! Into the stands! Floats it outside off, Dwaine lunges into this and drives it up and over extra cover for a magnificent maximum!
Shorter again outside off, Andile looks to swing it through the leg side but gets it off the inside edge towards backward square leg for a single.
Shorter on middle, Dwaine backs away and cuts it towards covers for a single.
Ish Sodhi called back on.
Full toss on the pads, clipped to mid-wicket. New Zealand need 2 wickets to win and on the other hand, South Africa need 64 runs from 36 balls.
Tossed up outside off, Phehlukwayo goes for the fancy reverse sweep nut the sharp inward spin beats him to strike him on the body.
On a length in line of the stumps, Andile covers it nicely and defends it.
FOUR! Full delivery wide outside off, Andile drives it with an open face and manages to beat the short third man fielder to get a boundary to his name.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

Dropped! Boult is unlucky that he couldn't quite hold onto that one! Loopy delivery wide outside off, Dwaine reaches out to it and hits it uppishly towards widish long off. Trent Boult comes running in and dives in front to pouch it brilliantly but when his hands land on the ground, the ball pops out beacause of the impact. Single taken!
FOUR! Bowls a very full delivery on the boots, Andile gets a bit of bat on it and helps it down to the fine leg fence.
Serves a juicy full toss outside off, Phehlukwayo fails to capitalize on it and pushes it to short cover.
Fuller length ball, pushed back to the bowler.
Very full delivery outside off, Phehlukwayo looks to carve it through covers but gets beaten.
Good length delivery angling into Andile. He is opened up in his stance but manages to somehow keep it out.
Southee steams in from around the wicket and angles in a short delivery towards Phehlukwayo. He sways away from the line of the delivery to evade it.
Tim Southee returns for a bowl.
Floats it outside off, Dwaine guides it down to third man for a couple. He did not know what to do with it actually but adjusted well.
Shorter outside off, Andile rocks back and cuts it through point for a single to get off the mark.
Andile Phehlukwayo walks in next.

OUT! Plumb! Flatter in length on off, Parnell looks to defend but is too late to pick the change of pace and is rapped on the pads. The players appeal long and hard. Umpire gives it in favour of the bowler. Parnell ponders over the review but decides against it, as it did look plumb.
Floats it outside off, Parnell drives it towards covers from his crease.
On off, Parnell turns it towards mid-wicket once again.
Floats it on off, turned towards mid-wicket by Parnell.
Wayne Parnell is the next man in.

OUT! Luck parts way with Chris Morris! Good length delivery in line of the stumps, Pretorius closes his bat face early as he looks to tuck it across but gets a leading edge towards short cover. Morris anticipating that the ball would go through the vacant square leg region was backing up too much and unfortunately the ball lands in front of Dean Brownlie. He picks it up quickly and hurls in a backhand flick to score a direct hit at the bowler's end. South Africa are falling apart now. The Kiwis need 3 wickets for a victory.
FOUR! Shot! Short delivery on off, Pretorius clears his front leg and whacks it over mid-wicket and the ball rockets to the fence.
Fuller length ball angling into Morris. He has a swing across the line but mistimes it to mid-wicket.
Short of a length ball in line of the stumps, Morris hangs back and pushes it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Handy runs these! Boult comes steaming in and bangs in a well-directed short delivery, Morris manages to pull it down to fine leg and earns himself a boundary.
Fuller length ball outside off, Pretorius comes forward and pushes it to covers for a sharp single.
The umpire signals the start of the final Powerplay. 5 fielders are allowed outside the circle.
On off, Morris lunges and drives it to mid off.
Opens the face of the bat and guides it to third man for a single.
Drives it through mid off for a single.
Looks to drive it hard but fails to beat cover.
Flatter outside off, Morris plays it to point.
Driven through mid off for a single.
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Good length ball outside off, Pretorius plays at it but gets beaten.

On a length angling into Morris. He turns it towards in front of square and sets off for a run. Southee rushes across to it and has a shy at the non striker's end. Had it hit, it would have been close.
Chris Morris is the new man in.

OUT! The big fish departs! That's a huge blow to the Proteas! Good thinking by Boult to keep on testing de Villiers with short deliveries and it pays off. Bangs in a short ball outside off, AB goes for a full blooded pull shot but gets a bottom edge and the ball flies towards Latham. He crouches and takes a good low catch. New Zealand now surely hold the upper hand now. South Africa still need 91 from 69 balls.
Good length delivery angling in, AB hangs back and turns it to mid-wicket.
Bangs in a bouncer around off, de Villiers sways away from the line of the delivery to evade it. The umpire signals one bouncer for the over.
Trent Boult called back on for a bowl.
Short delivery outside off, AB camps back and punches it to sweeper cover to retain the strike. South Africa need 92 from 72 balls.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
De Villiers pushes it off the front foot to mid off.
Flighted delivery, eased with the spin to long off for a single.
Shorter one outside off, Pretorius guides it to third man for a couple.
The batsman drives this through the covers. One run added to the total
Loopy ball around off, Dwaine hits it over mid on and gets two runs for it.
Tossed up outside off, spinning away. Dwaine looks to defend but gets beaten.
Dwaine Pretorius is the new man in for South Africa.

OUT! The threatening 68-run stand comes to an end. A very crucial wicket for the Proteas this as Miller can run away with the game. Sodhi slips in the wrong 'un at a flatter trajectory on off. Miller camps back and looks to guide it with an angled blade but is late to read it. Ends up getting an outside edge and Latham behind the stumps takes a sharp catch.
Loopy ball on middle and leg, defended to square leg.
Fullish on the stumps, Miller drives it through mid on and hares for the single. The batsmen take on the fielder and come across for the second.
FOUR! That's cracked! Tossed up on the stumps, Miller sweeps it powerfully through square leg and the ball rockets to the fence.
Wide! Tossed up on middle, spinning down. Miller first looks to play at it but leaves it in the end. Sodhi is the only one who is appealing for a caught behind but the umpire rules it as a wide.
Floats it on off, Miller clips it through mid on for a single.
Miller comes down and hits it through extra cover where there is a fumble but no harm done.
FOUR! Innovation! Miller attempts the reverse sweep and gets it through backward point for a boundary. Superb shot!
Floated on off, turned towards mid-wicket by Miller.
Shorter outside off, guided down towards short third man by David Miller.
Fuller on off, de Villiers drives it through covers for a single.
Mitchell Santner returns for a bowl.
Flighted delivery, eased with the spin to long off for a run.
Tossed up around off, driven against the spin to mid off for a single.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.

NOT OUT! Quicker one around off, Miller goes for a full blooded pull shot but gets an inside edge and it goes off something to the keeper. There is a huge appeal for caught behind and the umpires walk across to each other for consultation. The soft signal is not out. Time for the replays. It shows that the ball hit the ground before lobbing onto his boot. Miller survives!
A caught behind appeal against David Miller has been referred upstairs. The soft signal is not out.
Loopy ball on leg stump, defended with the spin to mid-wicket.
Tossed up on off, eased down to long off for an easy single.
Drinks.
Shorter in length outside off, Miller looks to drag it through mid-wicket but finds the fielder as Ross Taylor dives to his right and stops the ball.
On a length on off, de Villiers clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter in length, Miller gets on top of it and pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
50-run stand up between de Villiers and Miller.
On a length on the stumps, worked through mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Top shot! Too full on off, AB de Villiers just presents the full face of the bat and gets it down to long on for a boundary. The mid on fielder tried getting across but the ball was timed too well.
Fuller on the pads, whipped through square leg for a couple of runs.
Flatter on middle and leg, turns in, Miller nudges it towards square leg. South Africa need 123 from 102 balls.
Shorter outside off, de Villiers cuts it through point for a single.
Worked through mid-wicket for a single by David Miller.
Shorter outside off, punched towards extra cover by Miller.
Flatter on off, Miller defends it towards the on side from his crease.
Floats it outside off, de Villiers drives it through covers for a single.

Pitched up outside off, left alone by AB de Villiers.
FOUR Leg Byes! Easy pickings! On a length but drifting down leg, de Villiers cannot clip it but the ball deflect off his pads down to the fine leg fence.
Too  full on middle, Miller digs it out towards mid on from his crease and takes a single. There is a shy at the non-striker's end but it is wide and that allows Miller to get back in time.

Length ball outside off, Miller dabs it down to third man for a single.
Tim Southee called back on for a bowl.
Floats it outside off, pushed to extra cover by de Villiers.
Shorter outside off, Miller punches it to deep point for a single.
Shorter on leg, spins in, nudged through mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller on the pads, Miller eases it to long on for a single.
Shorter outside off, de Villiers goes back and punches it through covers for a single.
Flatter on off, Miller gets an inside edge towards mid-wicket for a single.
Guides it behind point for a single.
Fuller on off, de Villiers turns it through mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter outside off, Miller punches it through point for a single.
Bowls it on middle, Miller clips it towards the on side.
Fuller outside off, de Villiers drives it through covers for a single.
Flatter on middle, de Villiers clips it towards deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Miller stays in his crease and defends it back to the bowler.
Wrong 'un from Sodhi outside off, goes further away, Miller fails to cut it through.
Shorter around off, de Villiers goes back and pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Too full on middle, clipped through mid on for a single.
de Villiers drives it through wide mid off for a single.
Shorter outside off, de Villiers slaps it behind point for a couple of runs.
Ish Sodhi returns for a spell.
Another drive into covers by de Villiers for a single.
Fuller on middle, pushed back to the bowler by de Villiers.
Fuller outside off, de Villiers drives it towards covers.
Bowls it around off, de Villiers looks to sweep it through but is hit on his pads. The players appeal but the umpire stays put. Replays show that he was hit outside the line and hence good call.
FOUR! Hit away! Shorter outside off, AB goes back and pulls it over mid-wicket. The fielder gives it a chase but cannot hall the ball back in.
Fuller outside off, AB de Villiers pushes it towards covers.
Back of a length outside off, Miller taps it towards the off side.
On a length outside off, de Villiers punches it through covers for a single off his back foot.
On a length on off, de Villiers defends it watchfully.
Back of a length outside off, de Villiers rides the bounce and dabs it towards the off side from his crease.
Shorter outside off, guided down to third man for a single.
Fuller outside off, Miller comes forward and drives it towards cover-point.
Shorter outside off, guided behind point for a single by Miller.
This one is hit straight to the short extra cover fielder.
Fires it outside off, Miller comes down the wicket to nudge it through the on side but fails to connect with the bat. The ball strikes him on the pads.
Shorter outside off, punched to covers by David Miller.
Fires it on the pads, Miller fails to clip it through and is struck on his pads.
Fires it on off, de Villiers punches it towards covers for a single.
FOUR! Too good! Too full on the pads, Miller clips it beautifully through the backward square leg region for a boundary. Brilliant way to get off the mark.
Works it through mid-wicket for a triple.
David Miller is the new man in.

OUT! Boult does the trick! On a length on off, Quinton de Kock gets under it and goes over mid-wicket. The ball flies straight into the hands of the fielder, Jimmy Neesham in the deep, who pouches it safely. De Kock will rue not making the chance count. A big wicket for New Zealand, can they force a collapse from here on? South Africa need 166 more in 152 balls.
Shorter outside off, de Villiers slaps it through covers for a single.
Southee, Boult having a chat, Kane chips in.
Shorter in length on the stumps, de Kock pulls it through backward square leg for a single.
Shorter outside off, de Kock places it towards point from his crease.
Trent Boult returns for a bowl.
Shorter outside off, de Villiers places it behind point for a couple of runs.
Short again from Santner, de Villiers stays back and defends it watchfully.
De Kock stays back and works it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Floats it outside off, played through cover-point for a single.
Fires it on the stumps, de Villiers is watchful as he stays back and defends it back down the wicket.
Shorter outside off, cut behind point by de Villiers for a couple of runs.
Lands it outside off, AB de Villiers carves it through covers for a single.
Flatter outside off, de Kock chops it towards cover-point and takes a quick single.
Floats it on off, de Villiers drives it through covers for a single to get off the mark.
Fuller on middle, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
11th ODI fifty for Quinton de Kock.

FOUR! Fifty for Quinton! Shorter outside off, de Kock goes back and punches it through covers. The fielder in the deep dives to stop the ball but ends up parrying it over the ropes. A fifty for de Kock!
De Kock comes down a touch and defends it.
Flatter on middle, AB defends it watchfully from his crease.
AB de Villiers walks in next.

OUT! Duminy throws it away! Floats it on the stumps, Duminy comes down to have a whack at it but plays all over it and is beaten comprehensively. Latham goes to his right and collects the ball. He is quick to whip the bails off and that should be it for Duminy. A timely wicket for New Zealand. Can they come back from here? South Africa need 184 more runs in 173 balls.
Shorter outside off, Duminy goes back and guides it past backward point for a couple of runs.
Shorter on middle, de Kock taps it towards square leg for a quick single.
Too full on middle, clipped through mid on for a single by JP Duminy.
Fuller on middle, de Kock works it through mid on for a single.
Mitchell Santner called on for a bowl.
Shorter on middle, de Kock works it towards mid-wicket from his crease for a single.
Spots Duminy coming down and fires it on the stumps, the batsman still manages to get it through mid on for a single.
50-run stand between de Kock and Duminy!
FOUR! Up and over! Fuller outside off, Duminy gets under it and lofts it over extra cover for a boundary. This is brilliant batting from JP!
WIDE! Floats it outside leg, Duminy looks to put it away with a shovel but misses.
Flatter on the stumps, nudged towards square leg by Duminy but not for any runs.
Shorter on the pads, Duminy tucks it towards the on side.
Floats it on the stumps, de Kock sits down to swing hard but gets it off the inner half through square leg for a single.
Fuller outside off, guided past cover-point for a single by de Kock.
de Kock looks to smash one down the ground but mistimes it back to the bowler.
Duminy comes down the wicket and lofts it over mid-wicket. The placement is good as there is no one in the deep. Three runs taken.
Floats it on off, Duminy pushes it towards covers leaning forward.
Too full on the pads, turned towards fine leg for a single.
Floats it outside off, de Kock flays it through cover-point for a couple of runs.
Too full on the pads, Duminy turns it towards mid-wicket from his crease.
Flatter on off, de Kock works it towards square leg for a single.
Square drives this one towards point for a single.
FOUR! Top shot! Floats it outside off, Duminy gets under it and lofts it over extra cover for a boundary. Superb use of the field placements there.
Another one on off, Duminy defends it watchfully from his crease.
Floats it on the stumps, Duminy keeps it out towards short mid-wicket with a lunge.
Ish Sodhi comes on for a bowl.
Punched into covers for a single by JP Duminy.
Shorter outside off, de Kock gets a single to covers.
Shorter outside off, Duminy cuts it to deep covers for a single.
Flatter on the stumps, Duminy turns it towards the on side from his crease.
Duminy gets forward and pushes it into covers.
Bowls it on off, Duminy comes forward and pushes it towards covers.
Drinks break.

On a length angling away from Quinton. He plants his front foot across and plays it towards the fielder at point. Wants the single but is rightly sent back by Duminy. South Africa need 211 runs from 198 balls.
Back of a length outside off, glided down to third man for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full length ball outside off, driven sweetly through covers for a couple.
Short of a length slanting across Duminy. He guides it nicely to third man for a run.
On a length shaping into de Kock. He turns it through mid-wicket for a single.
Full toss on off, JP makes room and places it through extra cover. Has played it in the gap and comes back for the second.
Shortish delivery outside off, punched off the back foot through point for a single.
Tossed up outside off, driven nicely through covers for a run.
Fullish ball on the stumps, defended off the front foot.
Short outside off, de Kock hammers it just wide of the bowler to his right and down to long off. Single taken!
Tossed up outside off, driven to sweeper cover for a single.

Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
In the air... but safe! On a driving length outside off drawing Duminy forward. He obliges and slices it towards Neil Broom at point but the ball falls just short of him.
Good length delivery outside off, JP stays back and dabs it towards backward point.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Fullish delivery outside off, Quinton comes forward and gets it from the inner half to mid-wicket.
Short of a length outside off, played with an angled bat to point.
On a length on middle and leg, de Kock turns it to mid-wicket to retain the strike.
Straying on the pads, nudged round the corner for a single.
FOUR! Well played! Fuller length ball angling in from outside off, JP comes forward and creams it through covers and the balls races to the fence. The timing was delightful there!
The batsman works it down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.

Short of a length delivery and it's straigter on this occasion. Duminy camps back and defends it back to the bowler. Very good over by Grandhomme and he bowls a maiden.
Fullish delivery on off, JP covers the line and defends it to the off side.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.

Fullish delivery on middle and off, defended solidly off the front foot.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

OUT! Bowled 'em! De Grandhomme sends du Plessis packing with an absolute ripper! Misses it completely and the ball swings back sharply to rattle his stumps. South Africa need 239 from 235 balls.

Jimmy Neesham introduced into the attack.
Short of a length wide outside off, Faf hangs back and plays it to third man to retain the strike.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! Flamboyant strokeplay! Good length delivery outside off, shaping in. Du Plessis backs away a touch and punches it beautifully through covers to get rewarded with a boundary.
Back of a length delivery outside off, shaping away after pitching. Faf plants his front foot across and lets it go.
Dug in short in line of the stumps, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.
On a length around the hips, Quinton tickles it but is not able to beat the fielder at short fine leg.
Boult slants across a back of a length delivery from du Plessis as the latter watches it go harmlessly.
Fullish delivery straying on the pads, de Kock clips it nicely through in front of square for a single.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
FOUR! De Kock is such a delight to watch! He is exquisite with his off side play. Leans forward to a fuller length ball outside off and creams it through covers to send it racing across to the fence.
Shorter length ball on middle and leg, de Kock gets up on his toes and plays it to the man at mid-wicket.
Full length ball attacking the stumps, de Kock drives it nicely to mid off.
Good game awareness! Fuller length ball around off, de Kock prods forward and pushes it to mid off for a sharp single.
On a driving length outside off, de Kock perhaps look to drive it a little too hard and gets it from the inner half of the bat to covers.
Quinton camps back to the back of the length delivery slanting across him and defends it towards the slip region.
Short of a length ball well outside off, du Plessis cuts it away to third man for a single and gets off the mark.
Straying on the hips, tucked round the corner for a run.
Fullish delivery in line of the stumps, de Kock clips it to mid-wicket.
Boult gets some good inward movement on this one. Gets it to nip back into Faf. He is cramped for room but manages to defend it down the track.
Wide! Boult gets his radar wrong this time and slips it down the leg side, du Plessis misses his glance.
Faf camps back to the good length delivery on middle and leg and turns it to the on side.
Bangs in a short delivery on middle and leg, pulled with ease through backward square leg for a run.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
FOUR! Good shot! Fullish delivery outside off, de Kock drives it beautifully through covers to fetch himself another boundary.
Full length ball on off, pushed off the front foot to mid off.
Driven through mid off by the batsman.
Faf du Plessis is the new man in.

OUT! Southee strikes with a beauty! His seam presentation was spot on and he gets rewarded for it. Hurls in a fullish length delivery on middle and leg and gets it to curve away appreciably. Amla plays all around it and misses it completely to get hit flush on the back pad. A straightforward decision for the umpire and the Kiwis come together with big smiles on their faces. That's a big, big wicket!

That's a peach of a delivery! Gets this to curve back in from a fullish length on middle, de Kock is squared up and looks to defend but gets it from the outer half of the bat to third man. Single taken!
Good length delivery on off, de Kock hangs back and defends it to the off side.
Good length delivery in line of the stumps, de Kock looks to play it across but misses and is rapped high on the pads. Stifled appeal for LBW turned down. Height was always a factor there.
Fuller length ball on off, de Kock covers the line and defends it off the inner half down the track.
Back of a length wide outside off, Hashim looks to dab it but gets a bottom edge to that one.
Bowls a good length delivery outside off, Amla doesn't fiddle with that one.
Goes round the wicket.
FOUR! Classy stuff from Amla! Short of a length ball well outside off, Amla hangs back and punches it with precision through point for an exquisite boundary.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Back of a length ball outside off, Hashim camps back and punches it beautifully through point for a couple.
Boult steams in and bangs a well-directed bouncer on middle and leg, Amla sways away from the line to evade it.
FOUR! Delightful! Fractionally overpitched outside off, Quinton leans ahead and drives it beautifully through covers to fetch himself another boundary. 8 runs from that over.
Very full delivery outside off, de Kock perhaps misjudges the length and looks to carve it away in the end but misses.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Straying on the pads, de Kock clips it beautifully through fine leg and the ball races to the fence.

A loud shout for lbw turned down! Southee angles in a length delivery from around leg stump, de Kock looks to clip it through but misses and is rapped on the pads. The umpire shakes his head and rules down the appeal. It looked like it pitched outside leg stump to the naked eye and the replays confirm so. Good decision not to review it!
Fullish delivery around off, driven to mid off.
Short of a length ball well outside off, de Kock bends a touch and places it nicely but finds the man at point.
Fullish and straying on the pads, de Kock picks it up nicely through backward square leg to retain the strike with a single.
Fullish delivery outside off, driven crisply to the man at covers.
Similar length ball outside off, Quinton shapes for the cut shot but gets it off the inner half to covers.
Shortish delivery outside off, played with an angled blade to point.
Fuller length ball outside off, de Kock transfers his weight on the front foot really well and strokes it through covers for a couple.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Trent Boult to bowl from the other end with the second new ball.
On a length in line of the stumps, Amla camps back and defends it to mid on.
FOUR! South Africa are away! On a drving length well outside off this time, Amla strides forward and creams it through covers for an exquisite boundary!
Bowls it on a fullish length on off, swinging away. Hashim comes forward and drives it towards mid off.
Fuller length ball outside off, Amla lunges forward and drives it from the inner half of the bat to mid off.
Bowls a back of a length ball outside off, seaming away after pitching. Amla points his bat skywards and lets it go.
Starts off with a fuller length ball around off, Amls prods forward and defends it to mid off.
We are back for the chase. Hashim Amla and Quinton de Kock will open the batting for South Africa. Tim Southee to start off with the new ball. Here we go...
